defect_observations: C004 annex 105-111: the value of the minimized two-point expression at h_* is asserted (as the 'centered two-point Bernoulli exponential expression') without writing the change of variables s = h(b^2 + sigma^2)/b, the form exp(-sq)(1 - p + p e^s), or the evaluation, and without a cross-reference to the proved minimization in thm:p15-conc-common-range; the identity checks out.

C006 body 153 / annex 241-244: B_1 is proved nondecreasing in sigma^2 where the source (p. 20) says 'increasing'; if strictness is intended, it follows from strict monotonicity of M_{b,v}(h) in v at the minimizing h but is not stated.

Source citation slips the treatment should not copy if attributions are added: Lemma 2's proof is pointed to 'Bennett [1]' (reference [1] is Bahadur-Rao; Bennett is [2]); Doob is cited as '[7, p. 314]' ([7] is Hardy-Littlewood-Polya; Doob is [4]); p. 24 refers to '(3.13) to (3.16)' although no (3.16) exists.

C009/C010: the definition (body 238-256) does not itself name U a (one-sample) U statistic; the term appears only later (body line 323) and in the C010 title's 'one-sample'. C010 does not say in words that (5.7) extends the bound (2.3), though the transferred common-range bounds make the relation visible. Judged present; noted for the author.
C002 annex 13-23: the final step of the Hermite remainder (the third derivative of the auxiliary function equals F''' - 6K) is left implicit; the zero count is written.
